integration: Nearest-neighbor resize to a 32x32 item sprite; preserve generated alpha.

prompts.normal: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Minecraft 1.16.5 Pixelmon inventory item sprite, original custom pocket creature spawn detector. Create ONE standalone pixel-art inventory icon only, suitable for a true 32x32 game sprite, with a small palette of about 12 colors, crisp hard square pixels and chunky dark 1-logical-pixel outline, hard stepped highlights and shadows. A compact palm-sized handheld radar gadget in a slightly diagonal three-quarter inventory pose, thick casing, round readable radar screen, a short antenna and tiny side control. Distinct silhouette, high readability at actual 32x32 size. Fill about 26 of 32 logical pixels, centered with transparent margin on every side. Render the 32x32 logical sprite enlarged uniformly as pixel art, not detailed high-resolution art. Genuine transparent alpha background. No text, letters, numbers, labels, watermark, ground, drop shadow, checkerboard or surrounding UI. No smooth gradients, blurry glow, realistic rendering or floating decorations. NORMAL CREATURE detector: graphite and silver body, mint green and emerald screen with a simple bright radar sweep and two large pale green contact dots. A subtle pale cream highlight on the rim. Friendly field equipment; balanced cool green colors. No star or crown.
